cases.question: Can shore staff travel for personal reasons?
expected_facts: International travel is only permitted with prior approval from management.
cases.rubric: Personal reason not explicitly covered by the policies

cases.question: Can shore staff be reimbursed for expenses incurred during a personal trip?
expected_facts: Receipt rules: All receipts must be submitted within 30 days of the trip date
cases.rubric: Expense not explicitly covered by the policies

cases.question: Can shore staff report grievances to HR?
expected_facts: Shore staff have the right to report grievances to HR. The following steps will be taken: * Initial review by HR
cases.rubric: Grievance not explicitly covered by the policies

cases.question: Can shore staff use company resources for personal purposes?
expected_facts: The use of alcohol or drugs on company premises is strictly prohibited.
cases.rubric: Personal use not explicitly covered by the policies

cases.question: Can shore staff be terminated for a minor infraction?
expected_facts: Disciplinary consequences: Disciplinary consequences for shore staff will vary depending on the severity of the infraction. Repeated offenses may result in termination.
cases.rubric: Termination not explicitly covered by the policies
